title: FareValidated
description: A fare product was presented and validated. Subject-linked because a fare cap is a sum over that person's journeys: settling it requires per-person state, and an entitlement class alone cannot express it.

subject_ref.description: Pairwise pseudonym of the traveller, issued by identity-gateway for the `transit` domain. Required to accumulate a daily or weekly cap.

asset_ref.description: Vehicle the validator is mounted in.

stop_ref.description: Stop the validation occurred at, where the validator is fixed.

product.description: Fare product presented. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

result.description: Outcome of validation. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

fare_minor.description: Fare charged in minor currency units. Zero for concessionary travel.

cap_reached.description: True if this validation brought the traveller to a fare cap.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
